title: Remove settings shell-presentation plumbing
prompt: Windowed OS is now the canonical internal desktop presentation. Remove the residual internal settings-host shell-presentation plumbing so settings surfaces no longer receive or branch on that host-only mode. Preserve the optional public extension compatibility field where external authors may still depend on it, and preserve existing settings behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Internal settings host rendering no longer passes or consumes shell-presentation mode.
Optional public extension compatibility remains intact rather than being removed globally.
Existing settings rendering and tests continue to work without stable-shell fixtures.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused settings host tests.
Run the desktop UI production build or its full blocking equivalent.

review.feasibility: Historical replay from the direct parent of a validated cleanup commit.
review.notes: Grade behavior and compatibility intent; exact diff matching is not required.

title: Remove native surface shell-presentation plumbing
prompt: Finish the canonical Windowed OS cleanup for native extension surfaces. Internal native surface hosts and their tests should stop injecting or asserting shell-presentation mode, while unrelated extension context and user-visible rendering behavior remain unchanged. Keep any genuinely public compatibility contract that still serves external extensions.
acceptance_criteria: Native extension surface hosts no longer inject internal shell-presentation state.
Tests describe and exercise the canonical native surface behavior without stable-shell fixtures.
Extension page rendering and unrelated context values remain unchanged.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused native extension host and extension page tests.
Run the desktop UI production build.

review.feasibility: Historical replay from the direct parent of a validated cleanup commit.
review.notes: The public compatibility boundary is deliberately part of the reasoning test. The ExtensionPage check is title-filtered because an unrelated Home assertion fails on the historical base.

title: Forward windowed app creation options
prompt: Bring the desktop HTTP and UI client extension-creation path to parity with the agent-facing extension manager. A caller must be able to create a `windowed-app` template and provide the supported appearance metadata through the typed client, route validation, and lifecycle call without losing fields or weakening existing validation.
acceptance_criteria: The typed desktop client accepts the windowed-app template and supported appearance options.
The extension creation route validates and forwards those options to the lifecycle layer.
Existing templates, validation errors, and default behavior remain compatible.
Focused route and client tests cover forwarding and rejection behavior.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused extension route and desktop client tests.
Run desktop main/server and UI builds affected by the contract change.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a complete route/client contract task.
review.notes: A correct alternative validation structure is acceptable if it preserves the same contract.

title: Persist runtime extension build errors
prompt: Runtime extension build failures currently disappear with the request or process that observed them. Make build errors durable enough to appear in installed-extension summaries across lifecycle calls, while preserving immediate synchronous error reporting. A later successful build or extension deletion must clear stale error state.
acceptance_criteria: A runtime build failure is retained and exposed through installed extension summaries.
Immediate callers still receive the synchronous failure rather than only stored state.
A successful rebuild clears the stored error.
Deleting the extension removes its stored error and does not leak state to a replacement.
agent_validation_expectations: Add and run focused lifecycle, registry, and registry configuration tests.
Run the desktop main build.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a bounded persistence and lifecycle task.
review.notes: The grader should inspect state ownership and cleanup, not require the historical data structure.

title: Refresh the extension registry after reloads
prompt: The desktop extension registry and App Manager can remain stale after extension reload, build, enablement, or maintenance operations until the app restarts. Add a server-pushed invalidation path that refreshes registry consumers promptly, with clean subscription lifecycle and without introducing polling.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant extension maintenance operations publish a registry invalidation event.
Desktop registry consumers subscribe once, refresh after invalidation, and clean up correctly.
The App Manager and other registry projections see current extension state without restart.
The implementation does not poll and does not create refresh loops or duplicate subscriptions.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused server route and registry hook tests, including subscription cleanup and repeated events.
Run desktop main and UI production builds.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of an event path spanning server context, routes, client subscription, and UI state.
review.notes: Equivalent server-push mechanisms are acceptable if they fit existing boundaries.

title: Add workspace files to Start menu search
prompt: Extend global Windowed OS Start menu search to include workspace file matches by file name and relative path. Results must use the shared search contract and visual primitives, and selecting a file result must open a standalone Files window focused on that exact file rather than merely opening the generic explorer.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace search returns bounded file-name and relative-path matches through the desktop API.
Start menu search merges workspace file results with existing result kinds without breaking keyboard or empty-state behavior.
Selecting a workspace result opens or focuses a standalone Files window at the exact file.
Backend, client, Windowed OS UI, and integration tests cover result mapping and selection.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused workspace explorer, client API, WindowedLayout, and windowed-os-ui tests.
Run desktop main and UI builds plus the windowed-os-ui package build.
Describe how the visible Start menu selection path was verified.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a complete backend-to-window vertical slice.
review.notes: Visible path evidence affects validation-ownership scoring but automated checks remain the hard gate.

title: Add Home widgets and runtime extension autobuild
prompt: Complete the next Windowed OS app-composition milestone. First-party and runtime extensions need a typed Home widget contribution that renders through host-owned widget infrastructure over real Documents summary data. Runtime extension source updates must also rebuild and reload automatically so widget changes appear without a manual maintenance step.
acceptance_criteria: The public extension contract supports typed Home widget contributions without importing host internals.
The host projects and renders registered widgets on Home using shared primitives and real Documents summary data, including empty/error/loading behavior.
Runtime source changes trigger bounded rebuild and reload behavior without loops or stale registry state.
Extension boundary rules remain intact and focused backend, projection, lifecycle, route, and Home tests cover the workflow.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused extension lifecycle, Documents, projection, and Home page tests.
Run extension static boundary checks.
Build the system extension manager, desktop main, and desktop UI.
Verify the visible Home widget path and report what was not manually verifiable.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a roadmap milestone spanning public contracts, backend data, lifecycle, and visible Home composition.
review.notes: This task deliberately tests whether Flash can plan two coupled subfeatures under one product outcome.

title: Fix desktop activity startup stalls
prompt: Electron `neon-pilot://app` Activity, Home, Documents, and Inbox requests can stall during backend warmup when the machine has large Pi session JSONL files. Diagnose and fix the startup/catalog path so summary APIs become responsive without eagerly prewarming every live session, while preserving exact transcript detail when a conversation is actually opened.
acceptance_criteria: Summary and activity APIs avoid expensive full-session hydration during startup and remain responsive on large session histories.
Conversation detail still returns exact persisted transcript content when requested.
Run and conversation catalog behavior remains correct across cold start, refresh, malformed or partial session data, and cache invalidation.
The fix includes representative regression coverage and does not hide failures behind arbitrary timeouts.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused conversation service, session catalog, run store, and client API tests.
Run desktop main and UI builds.
Exercise or construct a representative large-session latency probe and report measured evidence.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a diagnosed startup bottleneck with catalog and detail-path constraints.
review.notes: Latency evidence is qualitative unless the future runner adds a deterministic fixture benchmark.

title: Add extension source reads and desktop search
prompt: Complete two remaining Agentic OS gaps as one coherent phase chunk. Agents must be able to read installed runtime extension source through a narrow public extension boundary before diagnosing or repairing it. Global Start search must also span conversations and scoped Documents text, with correct visibility filtering and literal handling of wildcard-like query characters.
acceptance_criteria: The extension manager exposes safe, permissioned source-file reads for installed runtime extensions through public extension contracts and narrow host shims.
Source reads prevent traversal, reject non-runtime or disallowed targets, and return useful typed errors.
Start search includes conversation and Documents text results with visibility scope enforced consistently.
Search treats wildcard-like user input literally, bounds result work, and maps selection to the correct desktop window or conversation.
Focused tests, extension boundary checks, extension builds, desktop builds, and visible search-path verification cover the phase chunk.
agent_validation_expectations: Run focused extension manager, lifecycle, Documents store/route, client API, and WindowedLayout tests.
Run extension static boundary checks.
Build the system extension manager, windowed-os-ui, desktop main, and desktop UI.
Verify representative source-read and visible Start search invocations.

review.feasibility: Historical replay of two coupled phase outcomes across extension security and desktop search.
review.notes: This level tests broad planning and boundary ownership rather than one-file implementation speed.

title: Remove the gateway server runtime
prompt: Complete the fork cleanup by removing the obsolete Gateway and Telegram server runtime as a product capability. Remove its state, routes, contributions, tests, and public backend API without damaging unrelated provider authentication, app events, extension registration, release smoke behavior, desktop fixtures, or stable user workflows. Do not leave dead compatibility shims for internal-only gateway contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway and Telegram runtime implementation, routes, state, contributions, and internal tests are removed.
Public extension backend gateway exports and documentation are removed or corrected without breaking unrelated extension APIs.
Provider authentication, app events, route registration, extension registry behavior, release smoke, and desktop fixtures still work.
Static searches and boundary checks find no reachable obsolete gateway contract or build entrypoint.
The deletion is auditable and avoids unrelated cleanup outside the removed subsystem.
agent_validation_expectations: Audit imports, scripts, docs, package exports, route registration, manifests, and release fixtures before deleting.
Run focused surviving provider auth, app events, extension registry, route registration, and server bundle tests.
Run extension boundary/API checks and desktop main/UI builds.
Report any intentionally retained gateway terminology with its non-runtime justification.

hidden_validation: test -z "$(rg -l 'telegramGateway|telegramAccess|telegramAuth|telegramCommands|gatewayState|extensionGatewayContributions|backendApi/gateways' packages extensions scripts tests || true)"

review.feasibility: Historical replay of a large validated subsystem removal.
review.notes: Expected paths include directories deleted by the reference; the validator accepts paths present at either base or reference.
